Interface MoveCommand

All Superinterfaces:
Command
All Known Implementing Classes:
BlockRollTooSmallCommand, BreakBlockCommand, CannotMoveCommand, EnterBoardCommand, ExactRollRequiredCommand, MoveBlockCommand, MoveBlockedByBlockadeCommand, MovePieceCommand, SickRollTooSmallCommand
public interface MoveCommand extends Command
A command that a player strategy may choose for the current roll. Besides running, it can answer questions, so strategies can compare commands without executing them. Every answer is no by default, and each command answers yes only to what it really is.
